description:
Three continuous real-vehicle recordings from a closed proving ground (Shanghai, China), sampled at 100 Hz and synchronised on a common time grid, providing about 4.4 min of aggressive-driving data.

  • data/1.csv — 8 420 rows, 118 columns, 84.2 s (Trial 1, used for sim-to-real fine-tuning)
  • data/2.csv — 9 216 rows, 121 columns, 92.1 s (Trial 2, used for sim-to-real fine-tuning)
  • data/3.csv — 8 819 rows, 121 columns, 88.2 s (Trial 3, held-out independent test set)

Channels include MEMS IMU tri-axial accelerations and angular rates, four wheel speeds, steering-wheel angle, body-frame velocities, and an RTK-GNSS/FOG velocity reference. Trials 1 and 2 are used to fine-tune the physics-guided LSTM, whereas Trial 3 is excluded from training and covers four driving regimes (Normal, Small Lateral, Slalom, Large Lateral).
notes: Data accompanying the manuscript "Vehicle Lateral Velocity Estimation System Embedding Time-Varying Cornering Stiffness Learning Considering Sim-to-Real Gap". Released under CC BY 4.0.
